title: Sword Art Online New Original Movie Directed by Shingo Adachi Gets 2028 Release Date & Staff Details
content: Sword Art Online revealed new information and details for its upcoming original anime movie titled Integral Domain . The film was teased with the words “a completely new original theatrical edition is in production” back in January 2024, while its initial announcement came in November 2022.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Sword Art Online Movie Teases Kirito & Asuna’s Return With First Look
content: Sword Art Online is returning to the big screen with a brand new feature film now in the works, and the first look teaser is gearing up for Kirito and Asuna’s big comeback. Sword Art Online’ s Reki Kawahara has a lot of different projects now in the works.
author: ComicBook

title: It’s Ninjas vs. Dinosaurs in Wild New Anime From The Apothecary Diaries Director – Watch Trailer
content: Ninjas and dinosaurs are about to clash in an epic battle in an original new anime from the same director behind anime hits such as The Apothecary Diaries. While there are a ton of major anime adaptations and returning blockbuster franchises now in the works in the near future , there are also plenty of original anime…
author: ComicBook

title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 Reveals First Look at New Character Makeovers
content: Delicious in Dungeon is now on the works for its big comeback with Season 2 of the anime, and has revealed a closer look at the makeovers for each of its characters coming in the new episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: 7 Relaxing Short Anime Perfect For Beginners
content: The ever-growing popularity of the anime industry has many curious people looking to venture into the world of exciting series. However, considering the number of series out there, with many of them being long-running or having multiple seasons, choosing the right series for you can be overwhelming.
author: ComicBook

title: Star Wars Reveals Packed Staff & Cast for New Anime Series
content: Star Wars is readying for the debut of its first full anime series later this Summer, and has revealed the talented production staff and voice cast behind it all. Star Wars and anime have been a great match so far as fans have gotten to see through three volumes of the official anthology series, Star Wars: Visions.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto: Every Akatsuki Member Ranked From Worst to Best
content: The Akatsuki are one of the most iconic villain groups in anime history , right alongside the likes of Hunter x Hunter ‘s Phantom Troupe and Bleach’s Espada. Almost every member has way more character than most Shonen villains.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’s Disappointing Record Could Trouble the Anime Film Industry
content: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle might just be the biggest anime film ever released. It has broken nearly every record an anime film has achieved, emerging not only as the most successful anime movie of 2025 but also as a film capable of competing with major Hollywood titles.
author: ComicBook
